**What**
- README news (2026/01 entry): `transfer_queue` and `vla` are no longer under `verl/experimental` — `vla` was moved to the standalone [verl-vla](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-vla) repository (#6162), and TransferQueue is open-sourced separately ([Ascend/TransferQueue](https://github.com/Ascend/TransferQueue)). The sentence now lists only `fully_async_policy` / `one_step_off_policy` (still present under `verl/experimental`) and points to the two standalone projects.
- README: the relative link to `recipe/README.md` 404s since `recipe` became a submodule (#4795) — now links to the README inside verl-project/verl-recipe.
- docs/data/transfer_queue.md: removed the dead relative link to `docs/storage_backends/openyuanrong_datasystem.md` (the file does not exist in this repo nor in the TransferQueue repository).
- Typo fixes across docs/ and examples/ (15 occurrences): Explaination→Explanation, GROP→GRPO (rollout_trace.rst), Plugable→Pluggable, releaes→releases (agent_loop.rst), Missmatch→Mismatch (faq.rst), convinience→convenience (verl_profiler_system.md), remeber→remember (sglang_multiturn/multiturn.rst), preffix→prefix (checkpoint.rst), mulitiple→multiple (nsight_profiling.md), targetting→targeting (device_tuning.rst), initalize→initialize ×2 (reward_loop.rst), batch_pocess→batch_process (one_step_off.md), implementaion→implementation (gmpo_trainer README), supoorts→supports (run_qwen3_5_35b_megatron.sh), validting→validating (full_hh_rlhf.py).

**Similar PR search**
https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+recipe+OR+transfer_queue+OR+vla+OR+typo — no open PR covers these fixes (the earlier external broken-link batch #7622 did not touch these internal links).

**Test commands run and results**
- Doc-only change; no code affected. Verified every updated link target resolves: `raw.githubusercontent.com/verl-project/verl-recipe/main/README.md` → 200; the TransferQueue and verl-vla repositories exist. Each typo replacement was applied with exact-occurrence-count verification (grep counts before/after).
- No CI workflows affected.

**AI assistance disclosure**
This PR was prepared with AI assistance (coding agent); a human reviewed every diff line before submission.

+Verl manages multiple RL roles, _Actor_, _Ref_, _Rollout_, _Critic_, _Reward_, which are implemented in different Worker classes. And these workers can be combined into one Ray Actor, running in a process group. Each RL role has its own profiling config group, `profiler`, which consists of three fields:
 
 * **`all_ranks` and `ranks`**. When `all_ranks` is set `True` then all ranks will be profiled; when set `False`, `ranks` will be profiled. By default, verl profiles the whole training process in a series ` worker_process_<PID>.<RID>.nsys-rep` files for each process rank. PID is the process ID; RID is the capture range ID.
 * **`discrete`**. When set `False`, all the roles actions in one training step will be dumped in one database. When set `True`, the actions annotated by `DistProfiler.annotate` will be dumped into a discrete database. In this case, each role's action occupies one `<RID>`.
